title: Ok midline quality polyester/cotton sheets
text:
Ok midline quality polyester/cotton sheets. I love high quality linens and I don't mind spending real cash on the good stuff. We have legitimate 800 thread count cotton sheets that are awesome and have lasted years. These sheets don't even come close to the softness or overall quality of those. The so called 1000 thread count is marketing nonsense because these are not 100% cotton - they made of a combination of cotton and polyester.

I've run these through the washer and dryer twice and they are shedding fuzz like crazy. The sheets did soften a bit and they are comfortable to sleep on. The full elastic bottom sheet is a very nice touch and helps keep everything in place over a thick pillow top mattress. The thicker fabric makes these more suited for cooler weather than midsummer for us though. I wouldn't expect to pay more than fortyish bucks for this set.
